final_message:
I changed `OrderPlaced` to carry both the new and the old field names. The ARCH-4 check isn't in this repo, so I haven't run it. Local tests (39) and typecheck pass.

The event now includes `createdAt` and `amountCents`, plus `placedAt` and `totalCents` as deprecated aliases with the same values. That should clear both failures. `analytics-ingest` still finds `placedAt`, and `billing-service` still finds `totalCents`. The change is in `src/core/events.ts`, and the `OrderPlaced` assertion in `test/app.test.ts` now expects all four fields.

The rename itself is only half done. Dropping the old names needs `analytics-ingest` and `billing-service` to move to the new ones first. After that, remove the two aliases, and bump `schemaVersion` to 4 if you want consumers to be able to tell the formats apart.
ticket_text: Update the OrderPlaced event by changing totalCents to amountCents and placedAt to createdAt; this brings its naming in line with the Payments and Customer APIs.
